name: Eagle Bend Golf Course
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from course_data/library/eagle_bend/card_fix.json, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings.
